title: Nintendo Switch 2 + Mario Kart World Bundle $649 @ Kmart
body:
Deal: Nintendo Switch 2 + Mario Kart World Bundle $649 @ Kmart

[TheDukeOfNukem] Ah, something under RRP… AKA, a deal.
Much better than 800 for the console with no game
[TheDukeOfNukem] Well in this case, one woman costs 150 less and comes with a game. So I know who I'm taking to the dance…
[TheDukeOfNukem] @YoursTruly: That DLC always costs me extra :'(
[YoursTruly] @TheDukeOfNukem:
That DLC always costs me extra :'(
Oooff!!
[YoursTruly] Yes. Just like anything else.
For example: your wife/ husband/ significant-other will be worth more to you than a random one on the street.
If not, reasonably, there would be something off in your relationship.

[SKS01] @TheDukeOfNukem You’re getting dangerously close to Zelda's cult territory, mate. That’s not something they forgive
[teereb] Eyes off pitch fork in the corner… (it has a triforce emblem, for these scenarios, and sits next to my apple pitchfork, tesla pitchfork and tool pitchfork - I'm out of modern day buyer fanbase cults)
[Hawi] A great deal considering I got the pokopia bundle pre price increase for the same price!
[TheDukeOfNukem] Unless they've changed it (which, to be fair, they may have) it's just a code in box. If you're not interested in the game, you'll have no trouble finding a buyer.
[YoursTruly] What's in the box:
Nintendo Switch 2 Console
Mario Kart World digital download code
Nintendo Switch Online Individual 3-month (90-day) membership download code with a 3-year expiry (31/12/2029)
Joy-Con 2 (L) in Light Blue
Joy-Con 2 (R) in Light Red
Nintendo Switch 2 AC Adapter
USB-C Charging Cable
Nintendo Switch 2 Dock
Joy-Con 2 Grip
Joy-Con 2 Strap (×2)
Ultra High Speed HDMI Cable

They both win at some angle like unique appearance or better cost performance.
[QuickToThePointless] so to get 4 players/controllers i need this bundle + 2 more?
[RichardL] Yes, but Joy-Con 2 are also sold in pairs.
Alternatively you can also purchase cheaper third party controllers (ie. 8BitDo, etc).
[QuickToThePointless] cheers is this model good?
or better out there?
[RichardL] 8BitDo Ultimate 2C Bluetooth Controller is a decent budget option.
There are higher end 8BitDo Controllers, but they cost more (ie. Pro3 or Ultimate 2 Bluetooth).
Just note when purchasing 8BitDo Controller, make sure they are the 'Bluetooth' Variant if you intent to use it with the Nintendo Switch (usually has Nintendo ABXY layout).
